verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks that customers set up by event type (e.g. `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`, with screening results in the payload). Each delivery carries a `webhook-id` header for idempotency, and signing is opt-in per account. This is a programmatic event subscription mechanism, though the depth of the documentation is only partly shown. Missing for 10: a full catalog of event types beyond WORKFLOW_COMPLETED, explicit documentation of how webhooks are registered (API or UI), retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
